text: Attempt 7 begins: attempt 6's rules (loan rule, fire rules, shore pumps), same opening, then fill every pocket of the map with dense strips (stripplan.py) and add police coverage for land value.

Attempt 7 started. Attempt 6 reached 120,770 with no great fire and a balanced budget, but ran out of land. This time: use every pocket of the map, cross the river 5 years sooner, and add police for higher land value (taller buildings).
Feb 2001: loan #2, 2003 district.
Sep 2001: water 8% spare at 2,120 people -> loan #3 early for the coal plant + 19 north riverbank pumps.
Feb 2002: loan #4 for the second coal plant + north job district (shops/factories at max demand).
Tax controller: shops 7 -> 8 (demand 1542), factories 7 -> 8 (demand 2000)
Tax controller: homes 7 -> 6 (demand -1595), factories 8 -> 9 (demand 2000)
Feb 2003: zoo from cash (home demand -1,741); finance ordinances + City Beautification.
Tax controller: factories 9 -> 10 (demand 1968)
Feb 2004: loan #5 for the seaport job strip + east-edge homes (unemployment 10%); line y22 to power the homes.
May 2005: loan #6: south riverbank pumps (water 7%), airport in the north-east (line through it, fire station).
Jul 2006: loan #7 for the stadium + 4 fire stations; district 5 from cash (one line tile to power its police-station cell).
Jun 2007: loan #8 (guard passed): east coal plant; dense factory + home block by the seaport (road y55 added; attempt 6 got this block only in 2013).
Tax controller: shops 8 -> 9 (demand 1207)
Tax controller: shops 9 -> 10 (demand 1043)
Nov 2008: 14 mid pumps from cash (water 8%); loan #9 (guard passed): road links east + south, seaport 2.
Nov 2008: loan #10 (guard passed): river crossing - bridge y69, west district x20-40 y48-69, road link to the west edge, west lake + shore pumps (6 years earlier than attempt 6).
Tax controller: shops 10 -> 9 (demand -550)
Dec 2010: loan #11 (guard passed) for a west-bank coal plant + fire station (power 8%); zoo #2 from cash (home demand ~0).
Apr 2011: south-east district x101-125 y97-110 (shops, homes) from cash.
Tax controller: homes 6 -> 7 (demand -27)
Jun 2013: cash -$4.6k; taxes 6/7/7 -> 7/9/10; loan #12 (guard passed) for the south mixed district (factories between home cells).
